data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 128.3m. During 2014 the syndicate recognised gross favourable development on prior accident year losses of GBP 8.7m (a release). This release comprised a GBP 2.6m reduction related to Storm Sandy, a GBP 3.5m reduction related to other large and small catastrophe events and GBP 2.6m favourable development on attritional gross claims and claim expenses driven by reported claims activity coming in lower than expected. The development was driven by favourable claims experience on catastrophe and attritional exposures, impacting primarily property and reinsurance lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior-year column) on liabilities page. Prior year development taken from Note 4 narrative which explicitly states a gross release of GBP 8.7m; components are explicitly quantified in the note. The mapping of component items to standard LOBs is partly inferred where the note does not explicitly allocate to statutory classes (e.g. 'other large and small catastrophe events' allocated to Reinsurance - Property). No gross claims development triangle was present in the provided pages to cross-check. Named events are mentioned without quantified net losses to the syndicate except where the note quantifies gross reserve movements.
